AI Engineer Co-op Student (12 Months)
Company: Symplistic.ai Canada Inc.
Location: Woodbridge, Vaughan, Ontario
Employment Type: Full-Time, Paid Co-op
Duration: January – December 2027 (12 Months)
Hours: 40 hours per week
Compensation: $23 CAD per hour
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (approximately 3 days per week in office)
Open Positions: 1–2About Symplistic.ai
Symplistic.ai is an enterprise artificial intelligence company with operations in Canada and the United States. We specialize in developing enterprise AI agents, intelligent knowledge retrieval solutions, and custom AI applications that integrate with organizations' existing systems, data, and workflows.
Our engineering team builds production-ready AI solutions using generative AI, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), APIs, and modern software engineering technologies.The Role
As an AI Engineer Co-op Student, you will work directly with Symplistic.ai's engineering team to design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise AI applications and intelligent AI agents.
This is a hands-on technical position intended for students pursuing Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a closely related academic program.
You will apply your classroom knowledge to real-world software engineering challenges, gain experience with modern AI technologies, and contribute to the development of enterprise software throughout the complete engineering lifecycle.
The placement combines practical software development, technical research, experimentation, testing, and production deployment under the supervision and mentorship of experienced engineers.Core Responsibilities
1. AI & Software Application Development

- Design, develop, test, and maintain AI-powered applications and enterprise software using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, and modern development frameworks.
- Build and enhance AI agents, generative AI applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and intelligent knowledge retrieval solutions.
- Develop backend services, application components, and data-processing pipelines using software engineering best practices.
- Implement and test integrations with large language models (LLMs), databases, vector databases, and enterprise systems.
2. Enterprise AI Systems & Integrations

- Design, implement, and test AI workflows connecting enterprise applications, APIs, databases, document repositories, and external platforms.
- Contribute to enterprise AI solutions involving intelligent search, automated information retrieval, AI agent orchestration, and business process automation.
- Develop REST APIs, backend functionality, and integration components supporting enterprise AI applications.
- Work with modern AI technologies, including IBM watsonx, large language models, and other enterprise AI platforms.
3. AI Research, Experimentation & Evaluation

- Research, prototype, and evaluate technical approaches to AI and software engineering challenges.
- Conduct structured experiments to assess retrieval accuracy, AI agent performance, model behaviour, system reliability, and response quality.
- Develop automated testing tools, evaluation pipelines, and performance benchmarks for AI-powered applications.
- Compare technical approaches, analyze experimental results, troubleshoot system limitations, and document findings to support engineering improvements.Additional Responsibilities

- Collaborate with engineers on the design and development of Symplistic.ai products and custom enterprise AI solutions.
- Contribute to software architecture, technical planning, debugging, and troubleshooting.
- Participate in code reviews, engineering discussions, and development planning.
- Build automated tests and assist with quality assurance and performance optimization.
- Work with structured and unstructured enterprise data.
- Maintain technical documentation, development records, and testing results.
- Support application deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
- Apply modern software engineering practices, including version control, collaborative development, testing, and documentation.Required Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field.
- Experience programming in Python.
- Experience using JavaScript or TypeScript.
- Understanding of software development fundamentals, data structures, APIs, and databases.
- Strong interest in AI, generative AI, machine learning, and software engineering.
- Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with an engineering team.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Interest in developing practical, production-ready software solutions.Nice to Have
Experience or familiarity with any of the following is an asset:

- Large language models (LLMs) and generative AI
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases
- AI agents and workflow orchestration
- IBM watsonx
- OpenAI or comparable AI platforms
- REST APIs and backend development
- SQL and NoSQL databases
- React and frontend development
- Cloud technologies and infrastructure
- Docker and containerization
- Git and GitHub
- Automated software testing
- AI evaluation frameworks and performance benchmarkingCo-op & Student Eligibility
This position is intended to be a formal, paid post-secondary co-operative education or work-integrated learning placement.
Applicants must:

- Be currently enrolled in an accredited Canadian post-secondary degree or diploma program.
- Have commenced their academic program before the beginning of the placement.
- Be studying in an academic program directly related to the technical responsibilities of this position.
- Be eligible to participate in a 12-month co-op or internship placement recognized by their post-secondary institution.
- Be eligible for their university or college to approve, monitor, evaluate, and certify the placement as a qualifying co-operative education or internship experience.
- Be legally authorized to work in Ontario, Canada.
- Be available for a full-time, 12-month placement from January through December 2027.
Eligibility for applicable government-funded student work placement programs will be assessed separately in accordance with program requirements.Placement Details & Learning Experience
The successful candidate will be employed as a full-time, fixed-term employee of Symplistic.ai Canada Inc. throughout the 12-month placement.
The student will receive:

- Direct technical mentorship and supervision from experienced engineers.
- Hands-on experience developing enterprise AI applications and production software.
- Structured onboarding, defined technical responsibilities, and ongoing learning opportunities.
- Regular technical feedback and performance evaluations.
- Opportunities to apply academic knowledge to practical engineering problems.
- Exposure to the complete software development lifecycle, including research, design, development, testing, deployment, and optimization.
- Opportunities to develop technical skills in AI engineering, system integration, software development, testing, and technical documentation.
Symplistic.ai will work with the student's educational institution to support placement monitoring, learning objectives, and required co-op performance evaluations.Why Join Symplistic.ai?
At Symplistic.ai, you'll gain meaningful experience building real enterprise AI systems rather than working exclusively on isolated academic projects.
You'll collaborate directly with experienced engineers developing AI agents, intelligent retrieval systems, enterprise integrations, and custom AI software used in real-world business environments.
This opportunity provides exposure to emerging AI technologies, challenging software engineering problems, and the practical development of enterprise-grade applications.
Join Symplistic.ai and gain hands-on experience building the next generation of enterprise AI solutions.Work Location
Symplistic.ai Canada Inc.
7050 Weston Road, Suite 224
Woodbridge, Ontario L4L 8G7
Hybrid work arrangement, approximately three days per week in office.
